      Insurance Laws, Rules, & Bulletins

      Disclaimer

      Legal Services is unable to give legal advice. Please consult an attorney if you need help with a legal issue or legal advice. If you have a question on a matter that is other than for the purpose of seeking a legal opinion or advise, please send your question in an email to doi@idoi.in.gov. A response could take about 7-10 business days.

      IDOI is tasked with enforcing Indiana’s insurance laws.

      Indiana’s Insurance Code, Title 27
      Insurance Regulations, Indiana Administrative Code Title 760
      Political Subdivision Risk Management Commissioner Regulations, Indiana Administrative Code Title 762

      Legislative Update Summary

      2018 Legislation Affecting the Insurance Code​

      Administrative Rules

      The Indiana legislature, through the enactment of statutes, grants IDOI authority to promulgate administrative rules.  Administrative rules have the force and effect of law.  These rules are subject to a comprehensive process that requires IDOI to publish proposed rules, hold public hearings to receive comment, and obtain approval from the Indiana Governor before rules become final and enforceable.  To view proposed and recent rules, click here for the current IDOI Rulemaking Docket. (Updated 10/1/2025)

      IDOI Rule Hearing

      The Rule Making Video page includes links to IDOI public hearings on proposed rules. Information provided ahead of the rule hearing can be found on the Rulemaking Docket.
